# tests/fixtures/fide_greats/

Status: DRAFT — test fixtures, not for publication.

`published_periods.json` (session ELO-9, Phase 3): a small sample of FIDE's published per-player calculations of the greats' periods, sixteen cases chosen by a fixed rule (ruling R79, `docs/decisions/D-0017_rulings-on-the-greats.md`: at most 30 player-periods; 15 here; ruling R80, `docs/decisions/D-0018_rulings-on-elo-9-questions.md`, added F-G15 and F-G16 in session ELO-10), for the rules `src/layer0_greats/` transcribes from the texts in force before July 2017 (`docs/research/VERIFICATION_RATING-REGULATIONS-2001-2017.md`; `docs/specs/SPEC-GREATS_v1_0.md` §6): F-G01 the 350-point rule before July 2009, F-G02 and F-G03 the 400-point rule from July 2009 (a capped game, and a gap of 351 to 400 points counted in full), F-G04 K 15, F-G05 the 400-point rule of the 2014 regulations; F-G06, the first period on a list before July 2014 whose sum ends in a negative half point that FIDE rounded towards +∞ (R74, SPEC-L0 §11, F-H09); F-G07 to F-G10, the first period with a tournament of each version (2007, 2009, 2014, 2017); F-G11 to F-G14, the periods either side of 1 July 2009 and of 1 July 2014; F-G15 and F-G16, the last period before the switch of rounding R80 dates to the list of November 2018 and the first after it whose sum ends in a negative half point, which FIDE rounded towards +∞ and away from zero (SPEC-L0 §11, F-H10). The full reproduction runs locally from the gitignored cache; only its counts are committed, in E20. Written by `tools/data/assemble_greats_fixtures.py` from the pages cached by `tools/data/fetch_greats_calculations.py` and FIDE's lists. Opponents are identified by the rating FIDE used, never by name, and no player's FIDE ID or event is recorded; the values are single figures quoted from FIDE's calculations and lists for verification, as in `tests/fixtures/fide_history/`. `tests/test_layer0_greats.py` checks `src/layer0_greats/` against them.
